title: S4 single-rule enforce — production evidence (dispatch-storm-enforce/v1, rule storm/post-cap-schema-rejection-signature/v1, consecutive branch only; positive enforce + negative rolling-only-shadow pair)
acceptance_scope: S4 ENFORCE production evidence pair: (positive) the ONLY production-supported branch of the authorized rule — same strict exact composite signature in the same segment with consecutive_count===4 && cap_after===3 && would_abort_basis==='consecutive' — fires a REAL abort decision through WorkerRunGovernor.enforceSchemaRejectionStorm → emitWorkerRunDecision → requestGovernorTermination → FirstWriterTermination (failureType schema_rejection_storm_enforced, signal schema_rejection_storm_enforce, enforce_rule_version dispatch-storm-enforce/v1, budget_kind consecutive, action abort_session_return_bounded_partial); (negative) a rolling-window trip (would_abort_basis==='rolling_window', consecutive_count 2 < 4) stays shadow-only — 0 enforce rows, run completes normally. Rolling-window trips NEVER enter control. No general total tool cap. Shadow rows remain mode observe/counterfactual. This dossier records that S4 enforce behavior is PRODUCTION evidence (real providers/tools, real audit rows), not synthetic-only. ENFORCE-* criteria remain unchecked; no commit/push.
production_evidence_note: S4 enforce behavior is production evidence, not synthetic-only: both runs below are real dispatch_agent worker runs (real deepseek/deepseek-v4-flash provider, real read tool, real schema rejections from the real tool schema), audited in .pi-astack/dispatch/audit.jsonl (gitignored mutable source; path reference only, no row content embedded). The positive run demonstrates the real abort decision (task failed, failure_type schema_rejection_storm_enforced, termination_owner worker_run_governor, abnormal closure complete, cleanup_done true, post-claim 0/0, 0 post-terminal rows). The negative run demonstrates the rolling-window trip staying shadow-only (0 enforce rows, task completed, owner run, normal closure, cleanup_done true, post-claim 0/0, 0 post-terminal rows).

replay_projection.note: Self-contained sanitized replay projections of both production runs: the exact pre-projected StormShadowEventInput sequences (safe booleans + opaque signature key_id/digest) reconstructed from the written shadow audit rows, plus each expected observation. No raw error text / field path / normalized descriptor / tool args are included — only the opaque HMAC digest the state machine compares. Replaying these inputs with replayStormShadow(events, {capAfter:3, windowSize:6, windowLimit:4}) must reproduce every expected observation exactly. The S4 enforce predicate (consecutive_count===4 && cap_after===3 && would_abort_basis==='consecutive') is then applied to the replayed observations: positive must yield exactly 1 eligible event (the unique 4th event), negative must yield 0. This makes the dossier recomputable even after the gitignored audit file disappears.
